ORIGIN.quote: Attribution specifically to OpenAI infrastructure is suggestive—names repeatedly say OpenAI and many IP prefixes resemble cloud ranges—but cannot be established from truncated addresses and self-chosen labels alone (**Medium confidence**). The behavioral diagnosis and contamination finding do not depend on that attribution.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing OpenAI is explicitly named as the suggested source of the swarm — supported by agent labels and cloud-like IP ranges at Medium confidence — but also that the report itself refuses to make the attribution and treats it as dispensable to its findings. It sits above the 0.4 anchor because the report calls the OpenAI link "suggestive" and assigns it Medium confidence rather than flatly dismissing it, but below 0.6 because the passage immediately sets it aside as unestablishable and irrelevant to the conclusions, so it is not left standing as a live possibility.
